subject.title: fix(browser): downloads complete over CDP connections

question: Should Playwright-backed `/navigate` treat captured attachment-download navigations as successful managed downloads when the captured download URL passes the existing browser navigation policy before `saveAs`?
rationale: The patch looks correct, but it changes a security-sensitive browser persistence boundary and a user-visible route response contract, which should be accepted by a browser owner rather than inferred from green tests alone.

options.title: Accept guarded navigate downloads
options.body: Merge once required checks finish, keeping the PR's policy-before-save ordering and optional `download` response payload.

options.title: Require more contract polish first
options.body: Ask for a small follow-up to further document or prove the `/navigate` response contract before maintainer approval.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded navigate downloads
recommendation.body: Merge once required checks finish, keeping the PR's policy-before-save ordering and optional `download` response payload.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the clearest current browser/download area owner from recent main history and adjacent managed-download work.
